sources.title: Install and set up the Vibe CLI - Mistral AI
Introducing: Devstral 2 and Mistral Vibe CLI

notes: Could not pin down what model 'mistral-vibe-cli-with-tools' is. I fetched Mistral's models overview page's raw HTML directly (not just a rendered summary) and it lists no model id containing 'vibe-cli' anywhere, active or deprecated; the changelog and the Vibe CLI docs (install-setup, ZDR-and-Vibe-CLI page) don't name it either, and it has no dedicated model card page. Mistral's Vibe CLI is powered by the Devstral 2 family, and this target's facts (262,144-token context, image_input+text_input+text_output) numerically match Devstral 2's published 256K context window, but Devstral 2 itself is now listed as deprecated on Mistral's models overview (deprecation 2026-05-22, retirement 2026-07-31, recommended alternative Mistral Medium 3.5), so even that inference is stale. Sibling ids mistral-vibe-cli-fast and mistral-vibe-cli-latest suggest an internal Vibe-CLI routing/alias scheme that Mistral has not published details of. Returning insufficient_sources rather than guess which underlying model 'with-tools' now maps to.
